---
name: site-check
description: Verifies a 3D or animated web page in real headless browsers before anyone else sees it. Shoots every view, light state and scroll position at desktop, tablet and phone widths in Chromium and WebKit (Safari), measures frame time, draw calls and triangles, catches page errors, failed requests, blank WebGL canvases, horizontal overflow and reduced-motion behaviour, and builds one contact sheet.
